IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Friday, August 21, 2026**

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA**
Fifty calls stacked deep with steady data center work. Whitehead, Inglett & Stubbs, and Miller Electrical all posting **$40/hr** cable and splicer gigs on the QTS Fayette DC—4-10s and 2-8s Mon-Sat, six-day grind but no surprises. Miller's cable splicer call bumps to **$40.90/hr** on a five-day rotation if you've got three years documented. Book's not drowning you here; solid entry point for traveling hands.

**LU-430 Racine, WI**
Microsoft Mount Pleasant is the story. Four contractors—Gerdes, Pieper, Staff Electric, and Kelso Burnett—all chasing the same **$62.51/hr** build. That's top-tier money for Inside JW work. Wisconsin reciprocal license or better, conduit bending skills, long sleeves mandatory. Eleven calls on the board, seventy-six hands waiting—Book 1's moving but this one pays to sit tight.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX**
Cupertino's Santa Teresa job in New Mexico is the outlier: **$55/hr** on a straight Inside JW call, **$1121/week per diem** for anybody 350+ miles out, NM State JIW License EE98J required. Rosendin's Meta El Paso running **$40/hr** base with a **$15 incentive** for hitting 90% of 60-hour weeks—all OT double time. Ten calls total; the Santa Teresa premium is real if you're licensed.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND**
Parsons Electric's Polaris Forge Data Center in Harwood dominates: **$44.80/hr**, **$100/day per diem** non-taxed, **$100/day M-F incentive**, **$150 weekends**, plus **$100/day** with ND license. Thirty-six Inside JW slots. Hunt and Northern Valley posting the same rate on Air Base work. Twenty-two calls, seventy-nine hands—Book 1 moving steady.

**LU-237 Niagara Falls, NY**
Lake Mariner Data Center and Amazon both paying **$48.20/hr**. Ferguson and O'Connell each running 7-10s day shift, capping intake at ten to fifteen bodies daily—orientation Tuesday only at O'Connell. Six calls, seventy-nine hands: tight board, good money, move fast if you're heading east.

**LU-354 Salt Lake City, UT**
Facebook Eagle Mountain, Rocky Mountain Power Terminal, Delta Center—multiple **$46.22/hr** Inside JW calls with five-day schedules and OT available. Wasatch and Rydalch throwing **$100–$150/day incentive pay** on ten-hour days. Twenty-one calls, seventy-one hands; book's healthy and work's distributed across solid contractors.

Data center builds and industrial maintenance are vacuuming hands nationwide—book depth is real everywhere, but money's concentrating in specialty infrastructure (power, thermal, security) where certifications and experience move you off the call sheet fast.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Friday, August 21, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** — 46 calls, 140 hands deep. NEW RIVER ELECT. CORP. is running hard: 40 JL slots on distribution rebuilds in Columbus with $125 night per diem and $125 bonus on 10-hour days (6-10s, CDL required); another 9 slots in Southern Ohio on 4-10s with optional weekends. CAPITAL ELECTRIC LINE BUILDERS wants 6 more with cable splicing chops in Johnstown ($100/day PD, OSHA 10, Class A CDL). This board is work.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** — 25 calls, 82 hands. SERVICE ELECTRIC owns the headcount: 17 JL on GA Power energize work at Social Circle ($46.8/hr, $150/day PD, 11 on/3 off), then 10 more on Georgia Transmission Company's same site at **$51.80/hr** — you need barehand cert for that one. INCEPTION ENERGY SOLUTIONS posting 9 statewide from Savannah at $46.8/hr. Solid rotation work if you're certified.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** — 10 calls, 79 hands. Cupertino Electric's Santa Teresa build is the standout: 20 Inside JW at **$55/hr**, **$1121/week per diem** if you're traveling 350+ miles (NM State JIW License EE98J required). Rosendin in El Paso hitting 42 bodies at $40/hr with $15 incentive push and all OT double time. New Mexico pay is running clean here.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** — 22 calls, 79 hands. Parsons Electric's Polaris Forge data center near Harwood is stacked: 36 Inside JW at **$44.8/hr**, $100/day non-taxed per diem, $150 weekends, plus $100/day ND license incentive on 6-10s. Hunt and Northern Valley both running Grand Forks Air Base work at the same rate. Incentive play is heavy here if you hold or can grab that ND ticket.

**LU-1249 Cicero, NY** — 29 calls, 49 hands. Riggs Distler and Asplundh running distribution jobs across upstate (New Lebanon, Delanson, Wilton, Lewiston) with $100–$126/day per diem and CDL A mandates. No posted rates on this board, but solid regional work with Asplundh's Delanson call at $126/day is the PD play.

Data centers and transmission are pulling the board right now — El Paso's NM build and Grand Forks' Polaris forge are where the density is moving.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Friday, August 21, 2026**

**LU-213 St John, NB** is running the hottest board on the dispatch — 14 calls, nearly 350 hands needed. Irving Oil Refinery shutdown work is the anchor: Stuart Olson's got 95 slots across day and night shifts (6x10s), Lorneville's sitting on 87 more with F3/F4 welders pulling night work, and B&W's holding another 56 mixed day/night. Minor outage work with day shifts is also live. This is sustained refinery maintenance, the kind of gig that runs for weeks. Book 1's getting cleared fast.

**LU-290 Portland, OR** has 23 calls stacked on the board with 47 hands needed — all Intel Ronler Acres tooling and fab work. Apollo's running CAD/BIM detailers, Charter's got fitters and orbital welders scattered across four separate tickets. High purity and tool install are the specialties driving demand here; this is semiconductor fab-adjacent work, not rough piping.

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is solid with 18 calls and 61 hands. BCS Mechanical's Sego Project in West Valley is eating calls: 15 journeyman pipefitters, 13 plumbers, and 5 apprentices, all 4-10s starting August 3. DSI's QTS work in Eagle Mountain adds another six pipefitter slots on a 5-8 schedule with flexibility into 5-10s plus an 8-hour day. This is new construction volume.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** sits at 12 calls, 56 hands needed. Apollo's DC2 Data Center in Aurora (6-10s, commercial rate plus incentive) and Kiewit's industrial work (PD $65, 5-9s plus Saturday) are the heavyweights. US Eng. Metalworks has stainless fitting fab night shifts; Murphy's Coors line filler requires OSHA 10. Mixed industrial and commercial.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** — tighter board with 8 calls, 27 hands. Graham's Cenovus maintenance requires current DISA certification; Gem and GEM are holding fab shop and outage slots. **$53.00/hr** on one call signals solid scale across the region.

**LU-525 Las Vegas, NV** is thin — one call, 12 hands, Four Seasons towers in Henderson, OSHA 10/30 required.

Irving Oil shutdown work in the Maritimes is pulling bodies east; data center and fab build-out are driving West Coast movement.
